turns.doctor_question: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
turns.patient_response: I’m here because the doctor who did my insurance physical said my weight was too low. I don’t really see it that way—I mean, I work painting, I’m up on ladders and moving around all day, so to me I just look lean. But they thought I should get it checked out.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any unintentional weight loss recently, or has your appetite changed for any reason?

turns.doctor_question: Have you ever intentionally tried to keep your weight low or avoid gaining weight, even if it meant eating less than you needed to feel satisfied?
